0: I loved you; even now I may confess,
1: Some embers of my love their fire retain;
2: But do not let it cause you more distress,
3: I do not want to sadden you again.
4: Hopeless and tongue-tied, yet I loved you dearly
5: With pangs the jealous and the timid know;
6: So tenderly I loved you, so sincerely,
7: I pray God grant another love you so.
